Begining: ^We grew up in the slums, surrounded by the tormented souls of both the dead and the living.
^Our mother tried her best, raising a set of twins on her own couldn't have been easy.
^She worked herself to death soon after our 8th birthday
^After that you were my rock, although I was technically older, You raised me. You got us off the streets. Got me this job. I owe everything to you. But I dont remember if I had ever said thank you.
^But I guess its too late for that now...
